$comment: League ranks (docs/leagues.md), used by plugins/modes/league/Rank.LeagueMode.js. Seven ranks a league, Bronze to Dragon, each at a League Points threshold; the rank earns the league's trophy of that tier. The rank interface (league_rank, 64; script 730) reads the league struct's threshold enum (param 1857) and trophy enum (param 2041) against league_points_completed (2614), and the rank names from enum 5201. The cache carries both enums for Leagues IV-VI; Leagues I-III's structs have neither, so their rows here are sent as overrides (the Wiki's thresholds, the cache's trophy items by name). `wiki` lists every league's thresholds from the Wiki's League_trophy page for the audit test against the cache's enums. As captured (227/00075 sub 13211, 227/00579, 227/00090, 227/01710 ...): varbit league_rank_notification (17299) = the number of ranks reached, sent at login and on the award that crosses a threshold, with the game message below; no popup.

message.text: <col=229628>You've obtained {rank} rank! You can claim your trophy from the Leagues Tutor in the main game.
message.source: capture 227/00075 (Iron), 227/00090 (Bronze), 227/01710 (Steel, Mithril), 227/01735, 227/01762, 227/01854 (Adamant, Rune, Dragon): the same line for every rank
